**TODO:** Add chapeter on doing "super-resolution" predictions (i.e. making predictions at higher resolution than the labels)

There are 2 things to include:

1. Applying a model to high res features. For example, you train a model on features/labels at the Admin level, then apply the trained model to 1 km res

1. Train a (linear) model on high res features, then make predictions up to the pixel level (or any resolution below the features). This entails applying linear weights to the feature activation maps and summing to get prediction maps from input imagery. Useful for highlighting regions of an image that contribute to the prediction.
